You didn't' - not filed. Echo candidates for this date are already Arabic in the transcript (04:02 يومي كان, 04:46 بيلبسوا, 05:02 أنا, 06:05 التنتين) - no new echo fixes. 12:11 date without 'u' (chat: alfain u sitt u 3eshreen) is chat-only (GR-19), not filed. 59:19 عليني -> علي is his own self-fix before Amal.

rows.medi_said: بنات أخوي uh, بـ um, بتلبس uh, costume.
rows.chat: bukra Halloween u banaat a5uy byelbesu costume
rows.why: Subject is بنات أخوي (plural) but he used the singular/feminine بتلبس; Amal questioned تلبس؟ and he switched to بيلبسوا.

rows.amal_said: costume in? ... Costume in to costumes.
rows.why: Two of a thing takes the dual ending (-ein), not tnein + singular; Amal offered 'costume in' (costumein).

rows.medi_said: um, بتحكي لي إنه لازم أشتري، uh, أكتر costume من costumeين.
rows.chat: 5atibti bte7kili nno laazem ashteri aktar min costumain
rows.why: 'More than two costumes' is aktar min + noun; he put the noun between aktar and min (her typed line drops it); she only asked ليش.
rows.english: she tells me I have to buy more than two costumes

rows.medi_said: سجاد طيارة or طيـ-- سجاد بطير.
rows.why: The carpet (it) flies needs the he-form بيطير, not the I-form بطير; Amal recast بيطير.

rows.medi_said: سجاد طيارة or طيـ-- سجاد بطير.
rows.why: One carpet is sijjade (sheet: 'carpet | Sijjade | سجادةة'); سجاد is the collective; Amal let it pass (my reading).

rows.medi_said: الـ، um, الصديق اللي، uh, بيساعدني. ... just what do you-- ساعد؟
rows.why: He used the present بيساعدني for a past event, then asked for the past; Amal supplied ساعدني (he had only ساعد).
Idafa order flipped and the owner ending put on the wrong noun; Amal recast عيد ميلاده and he repeated it.

rows.amal_said: You could use بكون عنا. ... As a like because it's habitual.
rows.why: For 'every year we have a party' he reached for past عمل; Amal gave habitual بكون عنا and he built بيكون عنا حفلة.
rows.english: every year there is a party

rows.medi_said: الـ-- مش أمل party. أمل؟ مش، مش أمل party.
rows.amal_said: مم. Why miss-- No miss. Why miss? ... it's not miss. ... ما عمل.
rows.why: Engine wrote أمل for عمل; a verb is negated with ma not mish - Amal: 'No miss. Why miss?' and recast ما عمل.
English 'party' inside an Arabic clause; sheet: 'party | 7afle | حفلة | 7afle' and he said حفلة at 10:41; pre-ruled do-not-correct (AR-1933).

rows.medi_said: أنا راح أروح، امم، إلا تعي-- امم، أبويه في عمان.
rows.why: 'Go (to) my father' needs a preposition (3ind / la-) before the person; Amal let it pass (my reading; line is fragmentary).
rows.english: I'm going to (see) my father in Amman

rows.medi_said: الـ card بس نسيت خلصته، خلصتهم.
rows.chat: ana salla7et el-card bas nseet a5also
rows.why: Second verb after a verb must be present (bare); Amal: 'نسيت أخلصه. Second verb present.'

rows.amal_said: أنا راح أحكي لك. We don't, we don't say just I will.
rows.why: ra7 needs a verb after it; Amal: 'We don't say just I will' and gave أنا راح أحكي لك.

rows.medi_said: Okay، أنا راح أشوفك. أنا راح أحكيلك.
rows.why: He meant 'I'll look at it (the homework)' but put 'you' on the verb; Amal said 'No.' then 'Nice' after أحكيلك - her No may target أشوفك.
rows.english: I'll look at it, I'll tell you

rows.medi_said: امم، ما يخ-- ما، اه، ما بيخد، امم، ولا حدا؟
rows.why: ولا حدا = nobody; he meant nothing; Amal recast ولا إشي and he took it ('ولا إشي, yeah').

rows.medi_said: أمل صوتك شوي، um, ah قصير؟
rows.why: قصير = short; for a low voice the word is واطي (sheet: 'low volume | Soat wa6i | صوت واطي'); Amal supplied it.
rows.english: Amal, your voice is a bit low

rows.medi_said: عشان نعزم عـ- عيلة خطيبتي لكباب.
rows.amal_said: على. ... invite to. Did we review invite to?
rows.why: 3azam takes 3ala; Amal said على and 'invite to. Did we review invite to?'
rows.english: to invite my fiancée's family for kebab

rows.amal_said: No. ... You invite people to the wedding.
rows.why: The invited people ride on the verb, 3ala goes before the event; Amal: 'No. You invite people to the wedding.' - he rebuilt بعزم حدا على.
'I get happy' is the n- form بنبسط, not ببسط (I make happy); Amal said No and he gave بانبسط.
He meant his nieces (بنات أخوي) but said his fiancée's daughters; Amal echoed it laughing 'Already?' and he fixed it.
rows.english: I get happy because of my nieces

rows.why: After lamma the verb drops b- and must match 'they' (the nieces); Amal repeated لما and he changed to بيلبسوا (person fixed, b- kept; right is my reading).

rows.chat: ana banbeset minnak lamma te7ki jumle sa3ba
rows.why: He misheard her صعبة as صادة and asked; she repeated صعبة.

rows.medi_said: أنا بنبسط بـ آخد، uh, صورة
rows.amal_said: Did we say, did we take the noun for s-photography? ... تصوير.
rows.why: After bi use the noun of the action, not a verb; Amal asked for the noun and gave تصوير ('you can't add be to a verb').
صورة = a photo; the activity noun is تصوير; Amal supplied تصوير and he said he'd learned it.
After bi the activity noun keeps el-; Amal recast بالتصوير. التصوير.
Command to Amal needs the feminine -i (her chat enbes6i); she said Nice by voice (chat alone is not a correction).
He could not recall 'to miss'; Amal supplied بشتاق (engine wrote بستاق).
ishtaa2 takes la-, not 3ala; Amal questioned عليك؟ and said No, he then said بشتاق لك.

rows.medi_said: أنا بكون مشتاق. No, that doesn't sound--
rows.amal_said: No. Bakoon, you didn't get habitual or conditional. So it's just now, I miss you.
rows.why: bakoon is for habit/conditional, not 'right now'; Amal said No and named the rule.

rows.amal_said: اشتقت. No al in the middle.
rows.why: Wrong past form of ishtaa2 (اشتعلت = it caught fire); Amal: 'اشتقت. No al in the middle.'
'When you weren't here' needs past kaan negated with ma; Amal prompted 'You weren't.' and he built ما كنتي هون.
Same اشتعل form she fixed at 38:58 for 'miss me'; she let it pass (could be the engine mishearing اشتاق).

rows.amal_said: Mm-hmm. بحمس. ... بحمس. أنا، أنا بتحمس.
rows.why: 'I excite (someone)' is بحمس; بتحمس is 'I get excited'; Amal recast بحمس, he asked 'What'd I say?'.

rows.amal_said: Wait. Do you mean next month for the next month?
rows.why: الماضي = last; he meant next (sheet: 'next / the coming (m) | El-jaay | الجاي'); Amal asked 'Do you mean next month?'.

rows.medi_said: أنا بتحمس لشهر، لـ... شهر الجاي.
rows.why: Noun + el-adjective phrase needs el- on the noun too; Amal recast الشهر الجاي.

rows.medi_said: أنا بتحمس, uh, شهر الـ ... (لشهر الجاي)
rows.amal_said: So in this case, 'cause you wanna say I am excited now, what would we use?
rows.why: 'I am excited (now)' is the participle متحمس, not the habitual بتحمس; Amal prompted and he said أنا متحمس.

rows.medi_said: Um, to arrive is بسوال. No.
rows.why: Letters of وصل swapped into بسوال; Amal said No / 'Just flip it' and he got بوصل.
Same swapped form again after her 45:19 fix; she said No again (GR-32: wrong form again after the fix is its own slip).

rows.amal_said: وصل-- 'cause you used بيتك so make it gender appropriate.

rows.why: 'I get hurt' is the t- form بتوجع; بوجع = I hurt (someone); Amal repeated 'I get hurt' and he later used بتوجع.

rows.medi_said: لما أ- أقص uh حـ- uh, حالي بالغلط؟

'From work' in general keeps el- after the preposition; Amal only asked for a harder sentence (my reading).

rows.amal_said: You're angry at him because he's annoyed? ... Or because he's annoying.
rows.why: مزعوج = annoyed (receiving); he meant annoying مزعج; Amal asked 'because he's annoyed?' and he fixed to مزعج.

rows.amal_said: That's, that's you're sad for them. ... أنا بزعل من أو بدايق.
rows.why: Upset WITH someone takes min; 3ala = feel sorry for; Amal: 'that's you're sad for them' and gave من.

rows.amal_said: بعدين لما takes-- لما is conditional so what does it take؟ ... يكونوا متأخرين.
rows.why: After lamma (conditional) an adjective needs ykoon; Amal prompted and gave يكونوا متأخرين.
3ind is negated with ma not mish; Amal recast ما عند and he said ما عندك.
وقفي = stop, not 'be upset'; Amal asked 'شو واقفة؟' and he said 'that's stop' and switched to إتضايق.
Command to her needs the feminine -i; her garbled reply ends in -i and he immediately said إتضايقي؟.
fadhal X over Y takes 3ala; Amal: 'That's more than' and he got على.
General things (coffee, tea) take el-; Amal recast القهوة على الشاي and he said 'Gosh darn it'.

rows.medi_said: أنا قهوة، uh, المفضل إشي عندي
